note: Generic facility types with illustrative terms for demonstration. Not offers from any real lender.

products.name: Receivables financing
products.description: An advance against invoices your business customers have not paid yet. Repaid when they pay.
products.cost_text: about 1.5-3% of the advance per month
products.term_text: until the invoices are paid, typically 30-90 days

products.name: Revolving credit line
products.description: A limit you can draw on and repay as needed. Interest only on what you use.
products.cost_text: about 12-24% a year on the amount drawn

products.name: Working-capital term loan
products.description: A fixed amount repaid in monthly instalments.

products.name: Merchant cash advance
products.description: A lump sum repaid automatically from a share of future card sales.
products.cost_text: a fixed fee of about 15-35% of the advance
products.caution: usually the most expensive option, and repayments reduce every future card payout
